title: Partial functors of a localized Quillen bifunctor are derived left adjoints
statement:
Use model categories and derived mapping-space adjunctions as in [lem-coef-model-infinity-derived-adjunction], and homotopy coherent localizations and coherent functor categories as in [lem-coef-system-localization-universal]. Work in universes containing all the following categories. Let $\mathcal M,\mathcal N,\mathcal P$ be model categories with functorial factorizations, and write $\mathcal M^c,\mathcal N^c$ for their full subcategories of cofibrant objects. Write $q_{\mathcal M},q_{\mathcal N},q_{\mathcal P}$ for localization at their weak equivalences. Let $F:\mathcal M\times\mathcal N\to\mathcal P$ be an ordinary bifunctor such that $F(A,-)$ is a left Quillen functor for every cofibrant $A\in\mathcal M$ and $F(-,D)$ is a left Quillen functor for every cofibrant $D\in\mathcal N$. Left Quillen here means having an ordinary right adjoint and preserving cofibrations and trivial cofibrations. Suppose a coherent bifunctor
$$B:\mathcal M_\infty\times\mathcal N_\infty\to\mathcal P_\infty$$
is equipped with a natural equivalence $B(q_{\mathcal M}A,q_{\mathcal N}D)\simeq q_{\mathcal P}F(A,D)$ on $N(\mathcal M^c\times\mathcal N^c)$, including its arrows and higher simplices. Then for every cofibrant $A$, there is an equivalence of coherent functors
$$B(q_{\mathcal M}A,-)\simeq\mathbf L(F(A,-)),$$
and for every cofibrant $D$, there is an equivalence $B(-,q_{\mathcal N}D)\simeq\mathbf L(F(-,D))$. These equivalences extend the specified comparison on cofibrant inputs using the canonical replacement weak equivalences. Each partial functor of $B$ at any object of either localized category has a right adjoint, with no simplicial enrichment or symmetry hypothesis.
